title: Josh Alexander vs. Moose: a stolen celebration
summary: Josh Alexander reaches the world championship only for Moose to take it away in front of his family. Alexander’s pursuit becomes a personal campaign to reclaim the moment and title he lost.

chapters.title: A triumph lasts only moments
chapters.result: Alexander defeats Christian, then loses the title to Moose’s cash-in.
chapters.context: Moose uses his Call Your Shot opportunity during the family celebration, turning Alexander’s greatest achievement into the beginning of a revenge story.

chapters.title: Alexander returns with a title match
chapters.result: Josh returns and announces his Rebellion championship opportunity.
chapters.context: His renewed contract and guaranteed match remove the obstacles between him and Moose. The chase now has a destination.

chapters.title: Alexander takes his championship back
chapters.result: Josh Alexander defeats Moose to win the world title.
chapters.context: The challenger survives Moose’s offense and finishes the match himself, delivering the payoff to the celebration stolen six months earlier.
